dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing from the mid-dorsal section to a sharp point at the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slight asymmetrical indentation on the lower left lateral margin relative to the right margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with a very light blue-grey tint across the primary dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low frequency; localized grey shadowing visible along the lower lateral flanks.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Distinct dark linear marks on the anterior dorsal surface and a single small dark speck on the mid-left dorsal plane.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A prominent, raised longitudinal ridge along the posterior half of the dorsal midline, casting a visible shadow/highlight transition.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Fine, parallel linear scratches on the upper left anterior dorsal region.
other_distinctive_markers: Sharply defined rectilinear dorsal ridge extending toward the tail.
